title: incident-bot: prioritize SLO-linked runbooks in automated diagnostics + add on-call quicklinks
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Prioritize SLO-linked runbooks in incident-bot automated diagnostics and show quick-access runbook links in on-call messages. Adds new ranking heuristics, unit/integration tests, and documentation updates.
description: Summary: Improve incident-bot automated diagnostics by preferring SLO-linked runbooks when generating suggested remediation steps and exposing quick-access runbook links directly in on-call messages. Motivation: Oncall engineers often rely on runbooks tied to SLOs for fast remediation. The existing autosuggest prioritized textual relevance which sometimes surfaced generic runbooks ahead of SLO-specific runbooks. This change increases the signal weight for runbook-SLO linkage, surfaces runbook priority in the diagnostics payload, and injects quicklinks into Slack/Teams messages for faster access. Changes: 1) Add runbook ranking heuristics in diagnostics pipeline that boost score for runbooks explicitly linked to the triggered SLO and for runbooks referenced in the SLO's alert templates; 2) Include an ordered quicklinks array in the diagnostics payload that contains title+url+reason (reason is a short tag like linked_slo or recently_used); 3) Render quicklinks in Slack/Teams notification attachments with an optional compact view for on-call rotation; 4) Backfill a lightweight index that maps SLO IDs to candidate runbooks to speed lookup and keep ranking O(1) at runtime; 5) Add unit and integration tests for ranking, payload shape, and notifier render paths; 6) Docs: update incident-bot runbook heuristics section and on-call quicklinks usage doc. Rollout plan: feature gate off by default; enable for 10% of orgs initially, monitor diagnostics quality and click-through on quicklinks; after 2 weeks expand to 100% or roll back via feature toggle. Related: ENG-2143 (runbook discovery) and ENG-2201 (oncall UX improvements). Testing: added 8 new unit tests and 3 integration tests that run in CI. Local manual test of Slack/Teams render performed. CI: one flaky notifier test failed on first run and was retried; all checks pass on green. Impact: improves mean time to resolution for SLO incidents by surfacing targeted runbooks; no breaking API changes because diagnostics payload adds optional fields. Checklist: [x] design doc linked in linear ENG-2143 [x] unit tests added [x] integration tests added [x] docs updated [x] feature gated [x] metrics/alerting hooks added for quicklink click-through
